headline: Gianluigi Donnarumma knows he's 'made mistakes' for Man City - Enzo Maresca
description: Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca has reiterated his support for Gianluigi Donnarumma but said the Italian goalkeeper knows he's made mistakes.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal tracking RB Leipzig's Nusa after Vinicius snub
description: RB Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa is being tracked by Arsenal ahead of the January transfer window. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Does Man United's coach matter? Could Jurgen Klopp reach Premier League glory at Old Trafford?
description: If Manchester United hired an all-time great like Jurgen Klopp, would they have won the Premier League? Let's find out!

headline: Are Arsenal too reliant on soccer's 'dark arts,' or is it just sour grapes?
description: Are Arsenal going too far with their theatrics, dirty play and gamesmanship? Or do people just have a problem with it because it's working? Our reporters air their thoughts on the 'dark arts' in pursuit of trophies.

headline: Anthony Gordon left Premier League for Barcelona to get 'respect' -- he's got it now
description: Anthony Gordon's move to Barcelona was a surprise to some, but he's become an instant fan favorite at Camp Nou as well as a key player for England.

headline: Tyler Adams: Bournemouth have 'turned a page' after seventh straight win
description: United States midfielder Tyler Adams has said his Bournemouth side have "turned a page" after a 3-1 Europa League win over Sparta Prague on Thursday.
